races.paceDynamic: Garavogue will likely lead with Babychino pressing from prominent position, creating a moderate but sustainable pace over this staying trip. scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Favors Class
scenarios.trigger: If Garavogue and Babychino set reasonable fractions without overdoing it early
scenarios.body: The pace will be manageable allowing the higher-rated horses to use their class advantage. Legendary Day and Laplander can use their hold-up style to pick off the leaders in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Garavogue and Babychino go too fast or one of them falters early
scenarios.body: The race will become a staying test where horses with proven stamina can grind out the finish. Fond Farewell's win record on similar going and Saccary's recent Goodwood second become significant.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely slow and no hold-up horse can generate enough momentum
scenarios.body: Garavogue can use his class edge to control throughout while Babychino stays close enough to pounce. The hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground against horses who haven't been asked serious questions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Limitation Exposed
scenarios.trigger: If the soft going and 2-mile trip finds out horses lacking true staying power
scenarios.body: Son Of Tyran's finishing fade becomes more pronounced while fresher or better-suited stayers emerge. All One Word's limited experience on this going becomes a decisive factor in a war of attrition.

watchPoints.text: Son Of Tyran typically fades in the finish and soft going will likely exacerbate this weakness over 2 miles
Babychino has shown no form on similar going conditions despite being likely to set or press the early pace
All One Word has only raced 3 times on soft/heavy ground with no wins or places to show for it
Garavogue's stamina is unproven over this 2-mile trip and needs monitoring if pace gets strong early
Fond Farewell is the only horse with a win record on similar going despite being lowest-rated contender

races.paceDynamic: Solid Performer will lead uncontested from the start with only Inishcorker and Limerick Star showing early pace, creating a sustainable rhythm that won't drain the front runner. The four hold-up horses (Arcadian Star, Crackling Fire, Western George, Therhythmofthenite) will need to overcome traffic problems and time their challenges perfectly in what could become a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Solid Performer gets an easy lead and maintains galloping room
scenarios.body: The confirmed front runner controls the tempo throughout and has enough left to resist late challenges. The prominent runners Inishcorker and Limerick Star track but cannot reel in the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Takes Over
scenarios.trigger: If Inishcorker or Limerick Star applies pressure to Solid Performer from halfway

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and the field bunches up approaching the final hurdle
scenarios.body: Traffic clears for the back markers who produce strong finishes, with Arcadian Star's proven soft ground form telling. The early leaders pay for their exertions as fresher horses sweep past.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make mistakes at hurdles or the pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: The race becomes scrappy with several horses still in contention at the last, allowing an opportunistic winner to emerge. Form goes out the window as jumping and positioning become decisive factors.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Solid Performer gets hassled early by Inishcorker or Limerick Star as he hasn't shown ability to quicken under pressure
Monitor the jumping of the four hold-up horses as any mistakes will end their chances with limited time to recover
Observe how quickly Arcadian Star can get into contention as his hold-up style requires perfect timing in a small field
Check if Western George shows more pace than usual as his low rating suggests he needs to race more prominently

scenarios.trigger: If Looking As You Are establishes uncontested lead and No No Fizz sits behind her.
